summary.headline: Anthropic pledges 5% of its shares to a fund for AI's economic impact
summary.body: Anthropic announced it will put 5% of its shares into a new Public Benefit Fund for AI's economic and labour impacts, subject to stockholder approval, which lifted Shared Prosperity by 0.70. The same day its own study showed entry-level workers fell from 27% to 9% of its technical hires, cutting Shared Prosperity by 0.30. Meta described its gigawatt-scale Prometheus supercluster (Capability Velocity +0.11) and DeepSeek released the open-weight V4.1-Flash-1017 update. Egalitarian Utopia rose 0.31, the day's only notable move. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance rose to -14.03 from -14.11.
summary.movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia +0.3, from Anthropic's Public Benefit Fund (+0.49), partly offset by its entry-level hiring study (-0.21). Reversion -0.1, mostly from Meta's Prometheus supercluster (-0.06). Benevolent Dictator -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.03) and the DeepSeek open-weight release (-0.03).
coming_up: Anthropic's Public Benefit Fund needs stockholder approval

events.title: Anthropic plans to put 5% of its shares in a Public Benefit Fund for AI's economic impacts
events.summary: Anthropic said it will commit 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund LLC to address AI's economic and labour impacts, subject to stockholder approval; the board may add 2% for each 50% rise in value. With founder pledges, about 20% of shares would go to the public good.
events.reason: A large equity commitment from a frontier lab to share the windfall; still an announcement pending approval, so T2 signal.

events.title: Anthropic study: entry-level share of its technical hires fell from 27% to 9%
events.summary: Anthropic's research on its own workforce found entry-level workers fell from 27% to 9% of technical hires since early 2025, as work shifted toward supervising agents.
events.reason: Measured data show AI shrinking entry-level hiring, but only at one firm, so T1.

events.title: DeepSeek releases open-weight V4.1-Flash-1017 with an 8x smaller KV cache
events.summary: DeepSeek published V4.1-Flash-1017 open weights on Hugging Face. It reports better reasoning, coding, agentic and visual benchmarks and a KV cache of 890 bytes per token, about 1/8 of V4-Flash.
events.reason: An incremental update to the already-scored V4.1 Flash; open weights spread capability; benchmarks are self-reported, so T1.

events.title: Meta details Prometheus gigawatt-scale supercluster, scaling toward ~1M GPUs
events.summary: A Meta engineering post describes Prometheus, a gigawatt-scale supercluster that trains its Muse models, with plans to scale toward roughly one million GPUs.
events.reason: A large compute build-out, but described by Meta itself and partly a plan, so a small F1 step.
